title.narrative: Decent employment for youth in Cambodia

description.narrative: With one in five Cambodians between the age of 15 and 24 and almost two thirds of the population being under the age of 30, Cambodia is home to the largest youth and adolescent population in the Southeast Asia region. The proportion of youth within Cambodia#s population grew faster than the overall population from 2007 to 2015 (2.4 percent compared to 1.9 percent). This frees-up resources for investment and family income growth, providing the basis of the #demographic dividend# which is highlighted by the RS IV of Cambodia (2019-2023) as one of the major opportunities for progressing Cambodia#s long-term development objectives. However, maximizing the benefits of the demographic dividend will inter alia require increased decent work creation to absorb the 160 ,000 young women and men entering the job market each year , and comprehensive workforce skills development to meet labour market needs at a time of rapid technological and structural change in Cambodia#s economy. The programme intends to support young women and men in Cambodia to increasingly obtain decent and productive employment opportunities by ensuring they are better able to meet labour market demand and are prepared for quality employment.
